We are one of the few companies globally that can provide governments and customers with an integrated energy offering. Delivering our strategy sustainably is fundamental to achieving our ambition to be a net zero company by 2050 or sooner.

  

It's an exciting time to join bp. Meeting the energy challenge requires many different approaches and solutions. And as part of Finance Business \& Technology (FBT), you’ll be fully connected into the world of bp. You’ll play an increasingly important part within a network of like\-minded colleagues partnering on strategic projects that stretch across the globe. And it starts with you. So if you want to be part of a caring, supportive environment where you can realize your full potential, we’re with you.

Services (ENS), responsible for designing, implementing and continuously improving bp's enterprise network services.

* Experience with SD\-WAN technologies and enterprise connectivity solutions
* Familiarity in diagnosing and resolving complex technical issues beyond standard operational support

* Knowledge with Juniper and Fortinet technologies, Aruba ClearPass
* Ability to reviewing wireless survey outputs and WLAN optimization activities
* Knowledge of cloud networking concepts within Azure and/or AWS environments
* Familiarity with network automation using Python, Ansible or REST APIs
* Exposure working in industrial or operationally critical environments

 **Partner with the best**

  

The Applications Engineer ensures Baker Hughes can deliver flawless execution through involvement in pre\-planning, job execution, and post\-job analysis. This position delivers a technical job program or application design that maximizes our opportunity to meet the job objectives in line with the contract terms and conditions. This position works seamlessly together with the Service Delivery Coordinators and other resources across organizational boundaries to ensure all aspects and constraints of the applications are understood and have been considered.

 **As a Applications Engineer you will be responsible for:**

  

* Ensure compliance with manage the Job Cycle (MtJC) process.
* Work with the assigned Service Delivery Coordinator/Salesperson to understand the client’s well construction or production objectives as well as the commercial terms for Baker Hughes (i.e. outcome based contract, line item contract, etc.).
* Perform offset job analysis and product/service specific engineering modelling calculations to understand application hazards and incident potential.
* Work together with all disciplines and stakeholders to ensure all aspects and constraints of the application and suggested products/services have been considered.
* Design a job program, including risk mitigation plans and contingency plans, that can meet the client’s objective(s), maximize revenue potential and ensure future job assignments for Baker Hughes.
* Work with the assigned Service Delivery Coordinator/Salesperson to ensure any risk of not meeting the client’s objective is communicated to the client using the appropriate channels/processes for the respective client.
* Accurately document any calculations/simulations/plan revision and/or changes during the project cycles for visibility to dependent teams and audit purposes.
* Provide on\-demand support in accordance with product portfolio or on\-call schedule for job execution.
* Compare job as\-planned versus job as\-executed, document any lessons learned and develop recommendations for further improvements to procedures to ensure continuous improvement takes place.
* Work on Field Incidents related to products/services.

Working closely with executive leadership, business stakeholders, solution architects, and IT teams, the role will drive architectural consistency, technology standardization, and long\-term scalability across the organization.


Key responsibilities include evaluating emerging technologies, guiding enterprise\-wide technology decisions, overseeing cloud adoption strategies (AWS/Azure), and ensuring architecture compliance with security, risk, and governance requirements. The role will establish reference architectures and best practices for API management, microservices, integration platforms, containerization, infrastructure automation, and enterprise data management.


The successful candidate will have a strong background in enterprise architecture, system integration, cloud\-native technologies, and large\-scale transformation programs. Experience with technologies such as webMethods, Kubernetes, AWS S3, PostgreSQL, MSSQL, Redis, Java Spring Boot, .NET Core, Docker, Jenkins, and Terraform is highly desirable. Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF, ArchiMate, or Zachman is preferred.


Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and documentation skills are essential to influence strategic technology decisions, chair architecture review boards, mentor architecture teams, and effectively present complex solutions to both technical and non\-technical audiences.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Define and maintain the organization's Enterprise Architecture vision, strategy, and technology roadmap.
* Establish enterprise architecture standards, principles, governance processes, and reference architectures.
* Ensure alignment between business strategy, digital transformation initiatives, and technology investments.
* Lead architecture reviews and provide governance oversight across major programs and projects.
* Drive cloud transformation and modernization initiatives across AWS, Azure, and hybrid environments.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend strategic adoption opportunities.
* Collaborate with business and technology leaders to optimize application, data, and infrastructure portfolios.
* Promote enterprise\-wide integration, API, security, and data architecture best practices.
* Guide Solution Architects and technical teams to ensure architectural consistency and compliance.
* Support risk management, regulatory compliance, cybersecurity, and business continuity requirements.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* 12\+ years of IT experience with at least 5 years in Enterprise Architecture.
* TOGAF Certification preferred.
* Experience in enterprise technology governance and architecture review boards.
* Strong understanding of cloud platforms, integration architecture, data architecture, and security architecture.
* Experience within Banking, Financial Services, or large enterprise environments is highly desirable.


This version positions the role at a **strategic, enterprise\-wide level**, which is the key distinction between an Enterprise Architect and a Solution Architect.

**Skills:** Enterprise Architecture , Cloud Transformation , Technology Governance

jobs.title: Back-end C# / .NET Developer
jobs.description:
Jij bouwt aan het technische hart van onze e-commerce operatie: een event-driven landschap in AWS dat dagelijks 1.200 orders door meer dan 20 verkoopkanalen en 30+ landen loodst.
En je verkent met ons spec-driven development met AI-agents, waarbij het zwaartepunt van je werk verschuift naar intentie, architectuur en review.

De uitdaging

Ons e-commerceplatform wordt extern ontwikkeld, maar alle integraties tussen systemen en diverse eigen tools bouwen en beheren we zelf. Daarmee houden we de regie over performance, betrouwbaarheid en innovatie. Je krijgt een centrale rol in dat landschap: jij zorgt dat de keten blijft draaien en toekomstbestendig is, en je beslist mee over architectuur en technische keuzes.

Daarnaast werk je spec-first met AI-agents: je werkt uit wat een verandering moet doen, de agent bouwt, en jij verifieert build, tests en diff voordat er iets naar review gaat. Niets wordt ongelezen of onbegrepen gemerged. Deze aanpak is volop in ontwikkeling, en jouw ervaring en inzicht bepalen mede waar hij heen gaat. We zetten AI in als sparringspartner op complexe onderwerpen en versneller op duidelijke repitieve taken.

Wat ga je doen?

Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt back-end microservices in C# .NET (8.0), in leesbare en testbare code
Je bouwt en beheert event-driven integraties in AWS tussen ons e-commerceplatform, ERP (NetSuite), WMS en onze eigen tools
Je automatiseert binnen NetSuite in JavaScript/SuiteScript
Je zet AI in waar het jou versnelt, jij staat voor de kwaliteit, maar delegeert taken aan een agent waar dat voor jou werkt.
Je schrijft de spec, verifieert build, tests en diff van wat de AI-agent bouwt, en staat in voor wat er in de pull request komt
Je reviewt pull requests van collega’s en agents tegen de spec en onze standaarden
Je bewaakt performance, stabiliteit en security van koppelingen die wekelijks miljoenen berichten verwerken
Je vertaalt wensen van key-users en business owners naar een technisch plan dat je zelf implementeert

Wat werken bij KATO Group bijzonder maakt

KATO Group is onze bedrijfsnaam (Knives And Tools Online), Knivesandtools hoe consumenten in heel Europa ons kennen. Sinds 1999 is Knivesandtools dé snoepwinkel voor iedereen die houdt van hoogwaardige gear. Messen, keukengerei, bijlen, zaklampen, multitools, slijpsystemen, houtsnijsets… als het goed gemaakt is en leuk om te gebruiken, hebben we het waarschijnlijk op voorraad..

Achter die winkel zit een complex landschap van best-of-breed SaaS, eigen software en veel data. Je werkt in een klein IT-team en schakelt direct met Business Development, Finance en key-users uit de operatie. Weinig managementlagen, korte lijnen, en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief: je overlegt met de mensen die de beslissing nemen en met jouw oplossingen werken.

Wat wij bieden:

Een salaris tussen € 4.200 en € 4.800 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur
32 tot 40 uur per week, met ruimte voor ontwikkeling en een gezonde werk-privébalans
Toegang tot frontier modellen en coding frameworks voor agentic development
25 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantiegeld
Reiskostenvergoeding en een goede pensioenregeling
20% personeelskorting op ons hele assortiment aan Next Level Gear
Een platte, informele organisatie met korte lijnen en veel eigen verantwoordelijkheid
En ja: de beste koffie van Apeldoorn, verse lunches van onze chef Jesse, en een pingpongtafel voor de broodnodige pauze

Wat je meebrengt:

Ten minste 3 jaar ervaring als back-end developer
Sterke kennis van C#, .NET (8.0) en relationele databases
Ervaring met cloud omgevingen (AWS en/of Azure)
Ervaring met het reviewen van code van anderen
Uitstekend Nederlands en Engels in woord en geschrift

Fijn als je dit ook hebt

Ervaring met AWS Lambda, SQS, Terraform of andere IaC-tools
Ervaring met agentic of spec-driven development
Ervaring met JavaScript en/of SuiteScript (NetSuite)

Solliciteren

Stuur je cv met een korte motivatie: van jezelf, niet van AI. Geen lang verhaal nodig: we maken liever kennis in een gesprek op kantoor in Apeldoorn, gevolgd door een vervolggesprek met het team en soms een proefopdracht of meeloopdag. Daarna stemmen we de voorwaarden af en plannen we je onboarding met directie en teams.

jobs.description:
Senior Backend Engineer | Cybersecurity / AI | Hybrid, Amsterdam

Networking. Hacking. Streaming.

If you’re a strong backend engineer with hands-on experience in at least two of those three
, I’d like a conversation.

I’m working with a cybersecurity business where that combination will get put to proper use. There’s quite a bit I can tell you about what they’re building, but some of the more interesting detail is better saved for a call.

What I can say: there are substantial volumes of data, thousands of things happening concurrently and systems that need to work out what to do next based on what they’ve just found.

Making all of that work reliably is where you come in 🤞🏻

The work

You’ll build backend services and tooling, working closely with engineers and security specialists to turn complex ideas into working software.

Some days that means building a new capability. Others, working out why a database is struggling under load, where a pipeline is getting held up or how to stop one failed task causing a much bigger headache.

You’ll be involved in:

High-concurrency services and tools
, where performance matters.
Event-driven systems and streaming pipelines
, processing information at scale.
APIs and backend services
that other parts of the platform depend on.
AI-driven workflows
involving multiple steps, decisions and things that can go wrong.
Architecture and database improvements
, with ownership of getting them into production.

They want someone who’ll have an opinion. Spot something that could work better? Bring it up. Got an idea worth testing? Be prepared to get stuck in and see it through.

The person

You’ve built and operated distributed systems, you’re a strong developer in Go, C# or a similar language
, and you can talk through the decisions you made when things got complicated.

Then there’s the two-out-of-three bit:

Networking:
you understand protocols, connections and how systems communicate beneath the application layer.
Hacking:
you’ve investigated vulnerabilities, tested how systems can be exploited or built security tooling.
Streaming:
you’ve built systems that continuously process data or events, and dealt with the challenges that come with scale.

At least two is a requirement. All three would be very interesting.

I’d also like to hear about your experience with concurrency, asynchronous processing and relational databases. Python, Kafka, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL performance or autonomous agents
would give us more to talk about.

And if you’ve built your own tools, contributed to open source or disappeared down a technical rabbit hole because you needed to know how something worked, tell me about it. That stuff is useful here.

What’s in it for you?

Proper ownership, a technically demanding product and the chance to work closely with people who know their security.

There’s room to influence how things are built and grow towards Staff Engineering or Engineering Management
, depending on where you want to take it.

Equity, hybrid working in Amsterdam and loads of flexibility. And I mean that.

If you’ve read this and thought, “That sounds like me,” give me a shout. I’ll fill in the gaps.

This position starts with a 12-month contract, with the intention of offering a permanent contract based on mutual fit. (Dienstverband: tijdelijk met uitzicht op vast)

Eli Lilly is investing €2.6 billion in a new state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Katwijk, Netherlands. This facility will produce oral medicines for cardiometabolic health, neuroscience, oncology, and immunology, incorporating next-generation manufacturing technologies including dock-to-dock automation, paperless manufacturing, and process analytical technology while achieving carbon neutrality and zero waste to landfills.

Position Description

The Senior/Sr. Principal Automation Engineer - Quality Assurance serves as the site subject matter expert for Computer System Validation (CSV), automation compliance, and data integrity for GMP computerized systems including DCS, SCADA, MES, Historians, Building Management Systems and supporting automation platforms.

This role provides strategic leadership for the validation, maintenance, and lifecycle management of GMP computerized and automation systems supporting Oral Solid Dose (OSD) manufacturing operations at the Katwijk site.

In addition, this role is also responsible for the definition, implementation, and maintenance of data integrity controls in GMP regulated computer systems. This includes working with Automation, QC labs, and Tech@Lilly persons to develop validation strategies for the approach to computer system validation in compliance with corporate standards; consultation and interpretation on applying and right-sizing validation requirements; maintaining corporate and site computer systems standards and practices; participating in internal and external Regulatory agency inspections; conducting evaluations of internal or supplier quality practices; maintenance of inspectional readiness; and external benchmarking of computer system validation practices. Finally, this position will leverage an understanding of GMP data flows (electronic and paper), the application of data management/integrity principles in the site's processes, and validation/maintenance requirements to support regulatory compliance, consistency, and sustainment.

Responsibilities

Deliver on CSV Processes and Data Integrity Sustainability

Establish and maintain CSQ support and DI sustainability processes.
Drive appropriate consistency in CSQ and DI controls.

Deliver Projects and Programs

Serve as the site subject matter expert for automation system validation including DCS, SCADA, MES, Historian, Building Management Systems and other GMP computerized systems.
Provide strategic leadership for CSV activities associated with automation systems throughout design, implementation, qualification, operation and retirement.
Lead the development and implementation of site CSV strategies and governance models to ensure the ongoing validated state of GMP computerized systems throughout their lifecycle.
Partner with Automation, Engineering, Quality and Tech@Lilly teams to ensure GMP compliance, data integrity and maintenance of validated automation systems.
Support commissioning, qualification and validation activities for automated manufacturing systems and equipment.

Grow Capabilities And Knowledge

Mentor others in DI and CSV-related roles.
Grow capabilities of those performing DI CSV activities.

Maintain Inspection Readiness

Provide consulting and interpretation on Corporate Computer Systems/Data Integrity standards and practices as implemented at the Katwijk site.
Provide cross-functional technical leadership in the event of serious quality-related issues with computer systems or data integrity.
Monitor current state of inspection-readiness.
Escalate issues appropriately.

Streamline and Continuously Improve

Promote common process and best practice across functions.
Identify systemic issues and trends across functions and drive improvement activity.
Understand the external environment/best practices and bring external learning back to Lilly.

Basic Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Life Sciences, or a technology-related field.
Minimum of 10+ years of experience in pharmaceutical automation, computer system validation (CSV), quality assurance, engineering, or related GMP-regulated manufacturing environments.
Experience supporting API and/or Oral Solid Dose (OSD) manufacturing operations.
Experience with automation platforms, manufacturing control systems and computerized system lifecycle management.
Candidates must have current authorisation to work in the European Union.

Additional Preferences

Direct experience with Computer Systems Validation (GAMP5) and data integrity basic principles (ALCOA+).
Previous experience in GMP or GLP environments.
Demonstrated strong oral and written communication skills.
Strong interpersonal interaction skills.
Proven ability to influence quality peers, IT SMEs, and upper management.
Previous experience in Business Quality Assurance and Automation.
Understanding of process development and/or improvement (e.g. Six Sigma).
Knowledge of Lilly business area and its impact to products and patients.
Experience with automation systems including DCS, SCADA, MES, Historians, PLCs and Building Management Systems.
Experience supporting commissioning, qualification and validation of automation systems in greenfield pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities.
Demonstrated expertise in GAMP5, Data Integrity, ALCOA+, and computerized system lifecycle management.
Experience leading cross-functional CSV and automation compliance initiatives.

Dit doe je bij de Belastingdienst

Tijdens deze stage werk je mee in een Agile Scrumteam waarin samenwerken, leren en ontwikkelen centraal staan. Je doet praktijkervaring op met softwareontwikkeling, moderne cloud-native technologieën en het werken volgens Agile- en DevOps-principes. Samen met developers, testers en andere IT-professionals werk je aan de modernisering van de dienstverlening van de Belastingdienst.

Je Ontwikkelt, Bouwt, Test En Verbetert Applicaties En Systemen Voor Verschillende Belastingmiddelen En Interne Processen. Daarmee Ondersteun Je Burgers, Bedrijven En Collega's Bij Hun Dagelijkse Werkzaamheden. Je Kunt Bijvoorbeeld Aan De Slag Met

het ontwikkelen, onderhouden en verbeteren van Java- en .NET-applicaties;
het automatiseren van beheer- en infrastructuurprocessen;
het realiseren van nieuwe functionaliteiten en oplossingen;

het bouwen en verbeteren van mobiele toepassingen.

Je leert werken in een Agile team volgens Scrum en SAFe methodiek. Daarbij maak je gebruik van tools zoals Jira en Confluence en neem je actief deel aan scrum-events. Ook doe je ervaring op met DevOps-werkwijzen en maak je kennis met platformen zoals OpenShift.

Je staat er niet alleen voor. Ervaren collega's begeleiden je tijdens je stage en helpen je bij het behalen van je leerdoelen. Daarnaast kun je aansluiten bij bijeenkomsten, zodat je een goed beeld krijgt van het werken binnen de directie Informatievoorziening van de Belastingdienst. Je gaat veel leren, krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en zij leren ook van jou. Met jouw frisse blik en nieuwe inzichten help je de Belastindienst hun informatievoorziening verder te verbeteren.

Wil jij jezelf ontwikkelen tot IT-professional en ervaring opdoen binnen een Agile DevOps-team? Vertel ze in je motivatiebrief welke onderwerpen jou aanspreken, wat je graag wilt leren en welke IT-kennis en vaardigheden je al meebrengt. De exacte invulling van je stage bepalen zij samen met jou.

€800

40 uur

Bijzonderheden

Deze stagevacature wordt gesloten zodra een geschikte student is geselecteerd. Wacht dus niet te lang met reageren.

Om stage te lopen bij de Belastingdienst, moet je een stageovereenkomst en geheimhoudingsverklaring ondertekenen en een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) overhandigen. De stagiair en de onderwijsinstelling moeten de in de stageovereenkomst vastgestelde geheimhoudingsplicht in acht nemen.

De belastingdienst ontvangt graag je motivatiebrief en cv in een Word-, Excel- of Pdf-bestand; na sluitingsdatum is het niet mogelijk om jouw sollicitatie in behandeling te nemen.

Bij de Belastingdienst werken ongeveer 28.000 mensen verspreid over het hele land aan een financieel gezond Nederland. Dat gebeurt met passende dienstverlening, door massale processen juist en tijdig uit te voeren én door adequaat toezicht uit te oefenen. De Belastingdienst is sterk in ontwikkeling en heeft de ambitie om de beste Belastingdienst voor Nederland te zijn met focus op fiscale taken en vakmanschap. jobs.title: Technisch Solution Architect OPM
jobs.description:
Over de functie

In het kort: Je gaat als technisch solution architect de brug slaan tussen business en IT, complexe softwareoplossingen ontwerpen in een Azure/DevOps-omgeving en teams coachen bij het verbeteren van architectuur, automatisering en softwarekwaliteit.

Dit ga je doen als Technisch Solution Architect bij OPM

Technisch Solution Architect Ontwerpen en Plannen Materieel (OPM): bouw mee aan de digitale ruggengraat van de treinreis

Werk op het snijvlak van business en IT in een domein waar een grote digitalisering gaande is.
Werk mee aan het oplossen van de complexe logistieke puzzels binnen het spoordomein.
Werk aan een duurzame samenleving waarin treinvervoer vanuit milieuoogpunt en door verstedelijking steeds belangrijker wordt.

Pieter: “Het is supertof om aan software bij te dragen waardoor Nederland bereikbaar blijft.”

Dit ga je doen als Technisch Solution Architect bij OPM

Als onze solution architect sla jij de brug tussen de businessprocessen en de IT. Je bent actief op de werkvloer tussen en met onze teams. Op basis van de businesswensen ontwerp je samen met de lead developers de techniek en functionaliteit voor de realisatie van complexe onderdelen. De techniek is hierbij vooral jouw aandachtspunt. Daarbij houd je rekening met kaders en doelstellingen als standaardisatie, schaalbaarheid, herbruikbaarheid, performance, security en beschikbaarheid.

In afstemming met de andere (solution-/lead-) architecten in het cluster ontwikkel jij je toekomstvisie op de positie van onze softwarecomponenten in het bredere applicatielandschap van NS. Jij draagt er zorg voor dat onze (high-level) oplossingsrichtingen in lijn zijn met de wet- en regelgeving en de NS- architectuurkaders. Je blijft op de hoogte van de ontwikkelingen in de organisatie en bepaalt impact van veranderingen op (lopende) projecten. Uiteraard ben jij ook een kenner en voorvechter van onze geprefereerde manier van werken: we werken in een Agile framework (SAFe) en we zetten vol in op DevOps zaken zoals Continuous Delivery en Continuous Integration.

Een Greep Uit Jouw Dagelijkse Werkzaamheden

Ontwerpen van (high-level) functionele en technische oplossingsrichtingen, in lijn met de gestelde eisen, samen met de lead developers.
Adviseren over gekozen oplossingen bij stakeholders zoals de Product Owners, IT lead en Lead Solution Architect.
Regie nemen op en richting geven aan de voor de technische architectuur benodigde deliverables (denk hierbij bijvoorbeeld aan de inrichting van de Cloud omgeving zowel binnen als buiten ons domein).
De teams adviseren over en coachen in hun automatiseringsslagen met als doel de continue verbetering van de werkwijze, de softwarekwaliteit en de ontwikkelsnelheid.
Documenteren en controleren van opgeleverde architectuur- en engineeringproducten.
Uitdragen van de doelarchitectuur en architectuur-roadmap van het materieel planningsdomein.

Onze organisatie is continu in beweging. Daarom zijn we op zoek naar een solution architect die niet alleen beschikt over een solide basis aan kennis en vaardigheden, maar ook potentie heeft om te leren en er plezier in heeft om zich aan te passen aan nieuwe situaties.

Hier ga je werken

Het cluster Ontwerpen en Plannen Materieel (OPM) is onderdeel van IT Operatie resultaatgebied 5. Dit resultaatgebied verzorgt de ontwikkeling en beheer van complexe IT-systemen die nodig zijn om een treindienst uit te voeren. Denk hierbij aan plannen en bijsturen van personeel, materieel en rangeren.

Binnen cluster OPM werken op dit moment drie agile ontwikkel teams aan de ontwikkeling van de nieuwe applicatie Maple, die het nieuwe proces van de materieelplanning moet gaan ondersteunen. Daarnaast staan we op het punt om twee nieuwe teams op te starten om nieuwe applicaties te gaan ontwikkelen. Dit zijn het Dienstregelingsportaal (voor het distribueren en verrijken van de dienstregeling van Prorail binnen NS) en de Materieelmodule (voor het maken van het MaterieelParkPlan). Daarnaast wordt in het cluster gewerkt aan grote NS-initiatieven (zoals Fundamenteel Spoor en ERTMS) die impact hebben op de businessprocessen en dienen te worden vertaald naar IT-impact op onze services.

We ontwikkelen binnen ons cluster niet alleen technologie, maar ook onze manier van werken. Zo zetten we vol in op DevOps en dat binnen een Release Train met verschillende Agile teams en een multidisciplinaire samenstelling. Ontwikkelvermogen is een cruciale competentie binnen NS. Het stelt medewerkers in staat flexibel in te spelen op veranderingen, snel nieuwe kennis te verwerven en samen te leren. We geloven dat dit samenwerking en innovatie bevordert doordat medewerkers openstaan voor nieuwe ideeën en continu verbeteren. De werklocatie is Utrecht en wij werken in een hybride vorm, zowel op kantoor als vanuit huis.

Dit zijn de eisen

Om als technisch solution architect volwaardig te kunnen functioneren dien je hoog over de volgende vijf disciplines te beheersen:

De business en de bedrijfsstrategie doorgronden.
Sterk kunnen communiceren ("from boardroom to engine room").
Modellen en stroomdiagrammen kunnen uittekenen.
Begrijpen hoe systemen tot stand komen (projectmanagement en ontwikkelprocessen).
De organisatie inzicht geven in non-functional requirements, zoals de balans tussen security, kosten en performance.

Dit Vertaalt Zich In De Volgende Functie Eisen

WO/HBO werk- en denkniveau en minimaal 5 jaar recente ervaring in een architectuur- of vergelijkbare rol.
Kennis van beheer, data- en securityrichtlijnen, en requirements engineering.
Aantoonbaar ervaring met architectuurmethoden, technieken, tools, frameworks, etc. Certificeringen zoals TOGAF en ArchiMate zijn een pré.
Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring met Microsoft Azure en Azure Kubernetes Service. Certificaten van Microsoft Azure en Kubernetes zijn een pré.
Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring met Infrastructure-as-code, met name Terraform
Ervaring met Scrum, SAFe, CI/CD en DevOps (mindset en tooling). Ruimschootse ervaring met het inrichten en beheren van CI/CD pipelines is vereist, met name in Azure DevOps
Ervaring met het implementeren en inrichten van monitoringtools zoals Datadog
Kennis van netwerktechnologiën en –infrastructuur (routers, vpn’s, loadbalancers, firewalls)
Je hebt ervaring binnen grote/complexe organisaties (logistieke domein is een pré). Je bent in staat om mee te bewegen met verandering en jezelf te ontwikkelen, zeker met de komst van genAI.
Je bent coachend naar de DevOps teams en begeleidt hen in hun dagelijkse ontwikkelproces.
Met jouw flexibiliteit en vermogen om samen te werken, versterk je de teams. Je bent nieuwsgierig en staat open voor feedback. Je leert snel van fouten en ervaringen en je kan je snel aanpassen in veranderende omstandigheden. Je deelt jouw kennis en ervaring met anderen en je stimuleert anderen om te leren.

Op NS kun je rekenen

Werken bij NS betekent dat jij hét verschil kunt maken in de wereld van duurzame mobiliteit. Jij helpt mee om Nederland bereikbaar te houden, voor iedereen. Bij NS krijg je veel vrijheid. We beloven je dat geen dag hetzelfde is. De kernwaarden van NS zijn open en betrouwbaar. Wij gaan voor resultaat en willen vooruit.

Eisen

Overige informatie

Optie tot verlenging: Ja, optioneel

Over de opdrachtgever

De Nederlandse Spoorwegen is de belangrijkste spoorwegexploitant van Nederland. Het bedrijf is verantwoordelijk voor het beheer en onderhoud van het Nederlandse spoorwegennet, evenals het exploiteren van treindiensten voor passagiers en goederenvervoer. De Nederlandse Spoorwegen bieden een breed scala aan treindiensten aan, waaronder intercitytreinen, sprinters en internationale treinen naar omliggende landen. Het bedrijf streeft ernaar om reizigers veilig en comfortabel te vervoeren van en naar hun bestemmingen.

jobs.title: Exploratory Test Engineer & Scrum Master (On-site, German Required) IRC301687
jobs.description:
Description

About the Client

Our client is a global leader in eye care, dedicated to improving lives by enhancing sight. With a strong portfolio of innovative products—including contact lenses, eye care solutions, and surgical instruments for cataract and retina procedures—they serve customers in over 140 countries. By advancing cutting-edge technologies and solutions, they continue to shape the future of eye health worldwide.

About The Project

As part of their ongoing innovation, our client is enhancing their medical devices with advanced connectivity features and cloud-based services. Since adoption of next-generation solutions is gradual, the project must ensure smooth integration between legacy and modern systems in real-world environments.

The mission is to design and deliver a comprehensive set of tools, services, and libraries that enable seamless interoperability of existing devices with both cloud and on-premises infrastructures. The focus is on ensuring data integrity, security, and interoperability across all systems.

Project Status

The project has successfully completed its high-level requirements definition and initial technical planning. The next stage involves detailed design, implementation, and verification & validation activities. To achieve this, our client is now scaling up the software engineering team and seeking skilled professionals to join this critical phase of development.

Requirements

Exploratory Test Engineer combines two complementary responsibilities in a split role (Scrum Master 20‑40%, Exploratory Device Testing 60‑80%). As Scrum Master, the role serves primarily the RTD FrontEnd development team and may expand to cover the VideoUnit team (approx. 20% SM capacity per team). As Exploratory Test Engineer, the role performs hands-on testing directly on the NextGenRS Refractive Treatment Device hardware in a regulated medical device environment.

The RTD FrontEnd is a Windows x86-64 embedded system hosting multiple applications (FESupervisorApp, FEUserApp, FELogTransport, FemtoScan Service) that drive the full clinical workflow from patient selection through treatment execution. The VideoUnit is a Xilinx Zynq Ultrascale Linux system responsible for real-time image processing, eye tracking (SmartCam interface), and the Ophthalmic Digital Microscope. Both systems are safety-classified software under IEC 62304 and require rigorous test coverage. The Scrum Master is a key role responsible for enabling team effectiveness and high-quality delivery in a safety-critical, highly regulated environment.

Core Qualifications Include:

3+ years of experience in exploratory or hands-on functional software testing, ideally on real embedded hardware or medical devices.
Familiarity with Session-Based Test Management (SBTM) or comparable structured exploratory testing approaches.
Practical experience with Azure DevOps (backlog management, sprint boards, defect tracking, build/release pipelines).
Solid understanding of Windows desktop application testing (UI workflows, configuration, error handling).
Ability to read and interpret C++ application architecture and system integration diagrams for test planning purposes.
Experience working in Agile teams using feature-driven development, time-boxing, and artifact management.
Interpersonal skills with a proven ability to achieve constructive solutions in cross-departmental topics, as well as in organizing and motivating team members.
Fluent English; intermediate-level German. Onsite, Erlangen, no home office

Job responsibilities

Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies for the FrontEnd team (sprint planning, daily stand-up, sprint review, retrospective) and optionally a second team (VideoUnit).
Coach team members on Agile/Scrum principles, continuous improvement, and self-organization; act as a servant leader and team advocate.
Identify and actively remove impediments; manage cross-team dependencies and escalate blockers to management as needed.
Maintain team health metrics (velocity, sprint burndown, defect aging) and communicate progress transparently to stakeholders.
Collaborate closely with the Product Owner on backlog refinement, sprint goal clarity, and Definition of Done alignment.
Support adoption of AI-assisted development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and Azure DevOps tooling within the team.
Facilitate continuous process improvement using retrospective data; drive Agile maturity across one or two Scrum teams.
Plan, design, and execute exploratory test sessions on the NextGenRS Refractive Treatment Device (hardware-in-the-loop), focusing on clinical user workflows of the FrontEnd application.
Apply Session-Based Test Management (SBTM) and exploratory test charters; document findings with clear reproducibility steps and severity classification.
Collaborate with software engineers and verification engineers to triage defects; create and track issues in Azure DevOps.
Contribute to test strategy and risk-based coverage decisions alongside the Quality and Architecture team.
Produce lightweight test artifacts required under IEC 62304 (test session reports, defect records, anomaly reports) in coordination with the Quality team.
Validate integration of FrontEnd with BackEnd, VideoUnit, and Refractive Server Device (RSD) at the system level during sprint deliveries.

What we offer

Empowering Projects:
With 500+ clients spanning diverse industries and domains, we provide an exciting opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking projects that leverage cutting-edge technologies. As a team, we engineer digital products that positively impact people’s lives.

Empowering Growth:
We foster a culture of continuous learning and professional development. Our dedication is to provide timely and comprehensive assistance for every consultant through our dedicated Learning & Development team, ensuring their continuous growth and success.

DE&I Matters:
At GlobalLogic, we deeply value and embrace diversity
. We are dedicated to providing equal
opportunities for all individuals, fostering an inclusive
and empowering work environment.

Career Development:
Our corporate culture places a strong emphasis on career development, offering abundant opportunities for growth. Regular interactions with our teams ensure their engagement, motivation, and recognition. We empower our team members to pursue their career goals with confidence and enthusiasm.

Comprehensive Benefits:
In addition to equitable compensation, we provide a comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes the overall well-being of our consultants. We genuinely care about their health and strive to create a positive work environment.

Flexible Opportunities:
At GlobalLogic, we prioritize work-life balance by offering flexible opportunities tailored to your lifestyle. Explore relocation and rotation options for diverse cultural and professional experiences in different countries with our company.

About GlobalLogic

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer
to join a small, highly experienced Epicor Labs team that transforms innovative AI concepts into enterprise-grade products trusted by enterprise customers.

This is a hands-on engineering role
, not a management position. You will design and build, set the technical bar for production quality, and provide the architectural judgement needed to take AI-driven products from promising prototype to something enterprise customers can trust with their business data.

What You'll Do

As a Principal Engineer, you'll play a key role in designing and delivering the next generation of AI capabilities across Epicor's ERP portfolio.

PoCs and MVPs in AI transformation projects inside enterprise ERP software - rapid exploration of new capabilities, with the engineering discipline to evolve the successful ones into production-grade services.
Cloud platform services - designing and building the services, APIs, and data layers that new AI capabilities run on, integrating with large, established ERP products.
Production readiness - bringing R&D output up to enterprise standard: reliability, observability, security, multi-tenancy, and safe failure behaviour.
AI engineering - integrating LLMs and agentic patterns into business software responsibly: guardrails, permissions, auditability, and designing for the probabilistic nature of AI components acting on real business data.
Raising the bar - architectural review across the team's workstreams, mentoring engineers at all levels, and turning good judgement into standards and automation rather than tribal knowledge.

What You Are Likely To Bring

Principal-level engineering depth in C#/.NET and/or Python, with cloud platforms (Azure preferred), and a strong record of designing and shipping production services. Our systems span both stacks - strength in one with working fluency in the other is the expectation.
Production TypeScript/JavaScript frontend engineering experience, including building secure, accessible user interfaces that integrate with enterprise web shells, APIs and backend services.
Experience designing and integrating enterprise information systems, with a strong understanding of data flows, system boundaries and the operational impact of change.
Ability to work effectively with data scientists and other AI specialists to turn data, models and experimentation into reliable, usable product capabilities.
Production ownership experience - you have run systems in production and carry the instincts that come from it: partial failure, resilience, blast-radius thinking, and designing for the incident nobody planned. This matters to us more than any specific framework.
Distributed-systems fluency: service boundaries, transactional thinking, multi-tenant design, API design and versioning.
Strong architectural communication - able to explain, document, and defend design decisions across teams, and to review others' designs constructively.
Pragmatism under real-world constraints: comfortable integrating with large, long-lived enterprise systems and choosing the achievable-good over the theoretical-perfect.

Highly Desirable

Hands-on exposure to AI-assisted engineering - building with LLM APIs, agentic coding tools, and prompt-driven workflows, and a grounded view of where they help and where they don't.
Experience taking early-stage products (PoC/MVP) to production, ideally in enterprise software.
AWS experience.
Complex business-domain experience - ERP, e-commerce, finance, logistics - and an appreciation of the cost of getting business data wrong.
Security instincts: least privilege, tenancy isolation, trust boundaries.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 3 months, you'll:

Deliver production-quality code
Own components from design through implementation
Contribute architectural improvements across the team

Within 6–12 Months, You'll

Lead the design of major platform capabilities
Become a trusted technical leader and architectural reference point
Mentor engineers and help raise engineering standards across Epicor Labs

About Epicor Labs

Epicor Labs is the innovation engine behind AI transformation across Epicor's ERP portfolio.

Our team explores new ideas, rapidly prototypes solutions, and turns successful concepts into production-ready capabilities before handing them over to product engineering teams.

We're a Small, Senior Team With

High autonomy
Minimal bureaucracy
Fast decision-making
Strong engineering standards
A collaborative culture where the best ideas win, regardless of title

You'll work alongside experienced architects, product managers, UX designers, and AI specialists to solve challenging technical problems with real customer impact.

Technology

C# / .NET
Python
Azure
TypeScript / JavaScript
REST & GraphQL APIs
Relational & document databases
GitHub with CI/CD pipelines
LLM APIs
AI-assisted development tools

About Epicor

At Epicor, we’re truly a team. Join 5,000 talented professionals in creating a world of better business through data, AI, and cognitive ERP. We help businesses stay future-ready by connecting people, processes, and technology. From software engineers who command the latest AI technology to business development reps who help us seize new opportunities, the work we do matters. Together, Epicor employees are creating a more resilient global supply chain.

We’re Proactive, Proud, Partners.

Whatever your career journey, we’ll help you find the right path. Through our training courses, mentorship, and continuous support, you’ll get everything you need to thrive. At Epicor, your success is our success. And that success really matters, because we’re the essential partners for the world’s most essential businesses—the hardworking companies who make, move, and sell the things the world needs.

Competitive Pay & Benefits

Health and Wellness: Comprehensive health and wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being.
Internal Mobility: Opportunities for mentorship, continuing education, and focused career goal setting, with 25% of positions filled internally.
Career Development: Free LinkedIn Learning licenses for everyone, along with our Mentoring Program to boost your personal development.
Education Support: Geographically specific programs to balance the cost of education with the benefits of continued learning and personal development.
Inclusive Workplace: Collaborate with a diverse team in an inclusive, global workplace that fosters innovation and celebrates partnership.
Work-Life Balance: Policies built on mutual trust and support, encouraging time off to rest, recharge, and reconnect.
Global Mobility: Comprehensive support for international relocations and permanent residency processes.

Equal Opportunities and Accommodations Statement

Epicor is committed to creating a workplace and global community where inclusion is valued; where you bring the whole and real you—that’s who we’re interested in. If you have interest in this or any role- but your experience doesn’t match every qualification of the job description, that’s okay- consider applying regardless. 

We are an equal-opportunity employer.

jobs.description:
Senior Product Engineer - Investments

About Kota

Kota is reimagining insurance and retirement benefits for the modern workforce. Through our two flagship products - Kota Platform, the first fully integrated benefits platform, and Kota Embed, our embedded insurance solution - we're making benefits more accessible, valued, and global.

Today, we power benefits for tens of thousands of employees at Europe's most forward-thinking companies, including Carwow, Tines, Zoe, and Remote. Founded in 2022, we've raised more than €20M from leading investors such as EQT Ventures, Eurazeo, Northzone, and Frontline, as well as founders and executives from Workday, Remote, Personio, OpenAI, and more.

The role & team

We're looking for a Senior Product Engineer to join the Investments team, building the product that powers workplace pensions, retirement savings and our spend product at Kota. It's a full stack role with a backend lean, your strongest expertise will be backend and you'll work in the frontend when the product needs it.

The Investments team owns more than pensions. On one side, pension infrastructure is genuinely complex: multi-provider, multi-market and largely unmodernised. You'll design the systems that connect pension providers to employers and employees, covering contributions, fund data, payroll integrations and compliance across multiple markets.

On the other hand, you'll own our Spend product. This lets employers create allowances and issue cards to employees, who get a virtual Stripe card they can add to Apple or Google Wallet and spend in real time. It spans card issuing, wallet provisioning, transaction flows and the controls employers need to manage it. We want someone who starts with the customer, not the code, and proactively adds to the roadmap rather than just picking up tickets. This is an autonomous role, you'll be trusted to make product calls, not just technical ones.

What You'll Do

Design and build the systems that power Kota's Investments products; pensions, retirement savings and Spend: contributions, onboarding, provider integrations, employer-facing configuration, card issuing and wallet provisioning
Own technical architecture for the Investments stream, integrating with external pension and savings providers as well as payment and card infrastructure (Stripe)
Contribute to frontend code (React + TypeScript) when a feature calls for it
Join client calls where it helps you understand or explain a problem, and proactively shape the roadmap rather than just picking up tickets
Use AI actively in your day-to-day work, for building, reviewing and speeding up how you ship
Contribute to code reviews and technical planning, and keep the systems you own stable and observable

Position Description

At CGI, you’ll turn complex public safety challenges into technology solutions that create tangible value for clients and the communities they serve. As a Technical Delivery Engineer within our Public Safety Business Unit, you’ll work directly with clients, operational users and CGI teams to move rapidly from problem to prototype, pilot and proven outcome. You’ll have the freedom to take ownership, explore creative approaches using modern cloud, software, data and AI capabilities, and apply sound engineering judgement in highly secure environments. Supported by a collaborative community of experts, you’ll help shape solutions across borders, emergency services and other public safety organisations, testing ideas quickly and identifying innovations with the potential to make a lasting difference.

CGI was recognised in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work List 2025 and has been named a UK ‘Best Employer’ by the Financial Times. We offer a competitive salary, excellent pension, private healthcare, plus a share scheme (3.5% + 3.5% matching) which makes you a CGI Partner not just an employee. We are committed to inclusivity, building a genuinely diverse community of tech talent and inspiring everyone to pursue careers in our sector, including our Armed Forces, and are proud to hold a Gold Award in recognition of our support of the Armed Forces Corporate Covenant. Join us and you’ll be part of an open, friendly community of experts. We’ll train and support you in taking your career wherever you want it to go.

Due to the secure nature of the programme, you will need to hold UK Security Clearance or be eligible to go through this clearance. This is a hybrid position.

Your future duties and responsibilities

In this role, you will combine hands-on engineering with a pragmatic consulting mindset to solve real operational challenges. Working closely with clients, users and CGI colleagues, you will take ownership of problems from initial discovery through to working prototypes, MVPs and pilots. You’ll translate complex needs into practical solutions across applications, APIs, data, cloud and AI, balancing pace and experimentation with the security, quality and engineering judgement required in public safety environments.

You will have scope to explore new ideas, test them directly with users and adapt your approach based on evidence. Working within a supportive, agile team, you’ll contribute to workshops, demonstrations and early-stage opportunities while helping successful innovations transition into longer-term delivery.

Integrate & Connect – Bring together enterprise systems, APIs, data sources and third-party services.
Innovate & Automate – Apply AI, including generative AI, LLMs, RAG and automation, where it delivers meaningful value.
Test & Evolve – Validate ideas with users, gather evidence and rapidly improve solutions.
Secure & Sustain – Ensure solutions are secure, maintainable and suitable for real-world operational environments.
Engage & Demonstrate – Contribute technical expertise to client workshops, demonstrations, discussions and emerging opportunities.
Scale & Share – Capture reusable approaches and support the transition of successful solutions into wider delivery teams.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

You should be an experienced software engineer who enjoys solving ambiguous problems and turning ideas into working technology. You’ll need broad technical capability, with depth in at least one area, alongside the confidence to engage directly with technical and non-technical clients. You should be curious about emerging technologies, comfortable making informed decisions and able to balance speed, security and quality. You’ll be supported by colleagues while having the autonomy to own outcomes, experiment with new approaches and continuously develop your expertise.

Strong software engineering experience, with evidence of designing, building and deploying working applications.
Broad full-stack knowledge, with experience across several areas of the technology stack and depth in at least one.
Strong proficiency in relevant technologies, such as React or Angular and Python, TypeScript, C#, Java or comparable languages.
Experience with cloud platforms, ideally Microsoft Azure.
Good understanding of APIs, systems integration and modern software engineering practices.
Practical experience or exposure to AI-enabled applications, including generative AI or LLMs.
Proven client-facing or consulting capability, with confidence communicating with both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including translating business and operational challenges into practical technical solutions.
Proven ability to work with ambiguity, take ownership and make decisions without continuous direction.
Ability to balance pace, quality, security and pragmatism within complex delivery environments.
Experience with Azure OpenAI/OpenAI, RAG, AI agents, automation, data engineering, computer vision, SQL or AI-assisted development would be advantageous.
Experience developing prototypes or MVPs, or working within public sector, public safety or regulated environments, would also be beneficial.

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.

Y
our initial focus will involve building the skill-based quoting agent for our next-generation quoting workflow, followed by engineering the subscription and entitlement engine for the Pulse commercial framework. Experience developing automated tests for software applications
Familiarity with continuous integration and delivery concepts and tools such as Jenkins, CloudBees CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar

Experience with Electron or applications built using web technologies
Experience with Windows packaging technologies such as MSI, WiX, NSIS, or similar
Experience working with Jenkins or CloudBees CI pipelines
Familiarity with Windows code signing and software publishing workflows

Experience using virtual machines or other automated test environments

Experience investigating intermittent or flaky automated tests

You enjoy writing code that makes software development and testing more reliable. You are interested in understanding how software moves from a developer's change to a tested customer release, and you like working across test automation, build systems, and desktop application behavior.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Location(s): London or Manchester

BAE Systems Digital Intelligence is home to 4,500 digital, cyber and intelligence experts. We work collaboratively across 10 countries to collect, connect and understand complex data, so that governments, nation states, armed forces and commercial businesses can unlock digital advantage in the most demanding environments.

Job Title: Software Engineer

Requistion ID: 120492

Location: London, Manchester or Leeds – Hybrid working offered, with consideration for both full and part-time applicants – please speak to your recruiter about the options

Grade: GG08 – GG13

Are you passionate about working with cutting-edge technology and self-motivated to find innovative solutions to complex challenges as part of a team who help keep the UK safe? Join BAE Systems as an experienced Software Engineer.

As a key member of a Software Engineering team, you’ll be working with our National Security Customers to build systems that support their core mission capabilities. You’ll work as part of empowered, autonomous DevOps teams with regular contact with end-users to flexibly and efficiently understand, design, develop, deploy and maintain applications and services. You’ll be encouraged to identify new ways of solving problems and get to work in a range of different teams across our customer organisations. You’ll be part of the biggest defence company in the UK however we have a startup-like culture nurtured by sports and social clubs, being a safe place to fail, meaning and self-fulfilment over business, and learning from our partners, suppliers, and peers.

We fully embrace DevOps ways of working in our teams, and build a very broad range of capabilities for our customers. We therefore value Engineers who enjoy playing a role in the full delivery lifecycle and are flexible to learn and pick up new technologies and approaches. You’ll be playing a role in identifying the right technologies to use for the job and be supported with training as needed through access to services such as Pluralsight.

Not only will your team be directly making a huge impact upon the systems you work on, you’ll be doing it for an organisation who makes a huge impact to the security of the UK.

About You

You will have experience in many of the following:

Programming in one or more of JavaScript, Java, .Net, Python
Collaboratively designing and building Proof of Concept or Production systems
Source controlling your code with Version Control Systems, for example Git, Mercurial, Perforce
Utilising CI/CD tools, such as Bamboo, Jenkins, TeamCity, Bitbucket, in order to streamline delivery of new features and fixes
Continual testing of code using Automated Testing Frameworks
Ensuring code consistency and quality by utilising static code analysis tools e.g. SonarQube
Team working inside an agile environment e.g. Scrum, Lean, Kanban
Common software design patterns
Using precedent and your own creativity to solve our client's challenges!

It would be great if you also had experience in some of these, but if not we’ll help you with them

Machine Learning software e.g. Amazon and Azure machine learning, or Google's TensorFlow
Deploying and managing in Cloud Computing such as AWS, MS Azure
Containerisation e.g. Docker, Kubernetes
Relational, document, or graph database systems
Software configuration and deployment e.g. Ansible

Security Clearance

Due to the nature of our work, successful candidates for this role will be required to hold an active eDV before applying for this opportunity.

How We Will Support You

Work-life balance is important; you can work around core hours with flexible and part-time working, and many of our roles include hybrid working enabling a mix of working from home and in the office
You’ll get 25 days holiday a year and the option to buy/sell and carry over from the year before
Our flexible benefits package includes private medical and dental insurance, a competitive pension scheme, cycle to work scheme, taste cards and more
You’ll have a dedicated Career Manager to help you develop your career and guide you on your journey through BAE
You’ll be part of our company bonus scheme
You are welcome to join any/all of our Employee Resource groups. These groups cover everything from gender diversity to mental health and wellbeing.

About Our Team

Our people are what differentiates us, they are resourceful, innovative and dedicated. We have a mix of generalists and specialists and recognise that this diversity contributes to our success. We recognise the benefits of forming teams from a mix of disciplines, which allows us to come up with cutting edge, high quality solutions. Our breadth of work across the Public Sector provides diverse opportunities for our people to develop their careers in new areas of expertise and with new clients.

You’ll be part of a big company, but we try to create a culture that feels like a small one. The work will stretch you and be challenging, but we encourage a healthy work-life balance. Most of all, we know teams who work well together also perform well. We’ll do everything we can to ensure you have fun at work, and in social activities outside of it whether that’s virtually or in person, as conditions allow.

We have a rich history of working within National Security. In fact, we have over 40 years’ experience of delivering advice and solutions to our customers in this sector, supporting them in carrying out their vital missions.

Why BAE Systems?

This is a place where you’ll be able to make a real difference. You’ll be part of an inclusive culture that values diversity of thought, rewards integrity, and merit, and where you’ll be empowered to fulfil your potential. We welcome people from all backgrounds and want to make sure that our recruitment processes are as inclusive as possible. If you have a disability or health condition (for example dyslexia, autism, an anxiety disorder etc.) that may affect your performance in certain assessment types, please speak to your recruiter about potential reasonable adjustments.

Please be aware that many roles at BAE Systems are subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors such as your nationality, any nationalities you may have previously held, and your place of birth can restrict the roles you are eligible to perform within the organisation. All applicants must as a minimum achieve Baseline Personnel Security Standard. Many roles also require higher levels of National Security Vetting where applicants must typically have 5 to 10 years of continuous residency in the UK depending on the vetting level required for the role, to allow for meaningful security vetting checks.

Life at BAE Systems Digital Intelligence

We are embracing Hybrid Working. This means you and your colleagues may be working in different locations, such as from home, another BAE Systems office or client site, some or all of the time, and work might be going on at different times of the day.

By embracing technology, we can interact, collaborate and create together, even when we’re working remotely from one another. Hybrid Working allows for increased flexibility in when and where we work, helping us to balance our work and personal life more effectively, and enhance well-being.

Inclusion is integral to the success of BAE Systems Digital Intelligence. We are proud to have an organisational culture where employees with varying perspectives, skills, life experiences and backgrounds – the best and brightest minds – can work together to achieve excellence and realise individual and organisational potential.

Division overview: Capabilities

At BAE Systems Digital Intelligence, we pride ourselves in being a leader in the cyber defence industry, and Capabilities is the engine that keeps the business moving forward. It is the largest area of Digital Intelligence, containing our Engineering, Consulting and Project Management teams that design and implement the defence solutions and digital transformation projects that make us a globally recognised brand in both the public and private sector.

As a member of the Capabilities team, you will be creating and managing the solutions that earn us our place in an ever changing digital world. We all have a role to play in defending our clients, and this is yours.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Engineering - Corporates, Financial Institutions & Sovereigns (Manchester)
jobs.description:
Senior Director, Engineering – Corporates, Financial Institutions & Sovereigns

Fitch Ratings

The Opportunity

Fitch Ratings is looking for a builder, a challenger, and a boundary-pusher to lead the engineering organization responsible for all applications and services powering our Corporates, Financial Institutions, and Sovereigns lines of business. This is not a role for someone who optimizes within the status quo — it's a role for someone who questions it, reimagines it, and has the courage and capability to do something about it.

As Senior Director, you will have executive ownership of four engineering teams comprising a couple of dozen engineers. You'll lead a talented, multidisciplinary group tackling some of the most consequential technology challenges in global financial intelligence — maintaining and evolving the systems that analysts and clients depend on today, while simultaneously building the next generation of platforms from a position of real creative freedom and organizational backing.

This is a role for someone who moves fast, experiments boldly, and doesn't wait for permission to try something new. Someone who has broken things in the pursuit of building something better, who sees constraints as invitations to be clever, and who brings an infectious sense of possibility that raises the ambition of everyone around them. If you've spent time deep in machine learning or AI systems — not just using them, but building them — that's not just a bonus, it's the kind of background that makes this opportunity even more compelling. But this role goes far beyond any single discipline: it's about leading a culture of relentless innovation across every dimension of how software gets built and delivered.

We'll Count on You To

Challenge the conventional and set a bolder technical vision
Own the strategic direction, execution, and engineering culture of four high-performing full-stack engineering teams. But more than managing what exists — interrogate it. Ask the uncomfortable questions about why things are built the way they are, and lead your teams toward answers that are smarter, faster, and more powerful. Set a technical vision that doesn't just improve the current state but genuinely reimagines what's possible for the platforms powering Fitch's most critical analytical work.

Build, develop, and inspire exceptional people
Lead, mentor, and empower a team of team leads and engineers across a range of technical backgrounds and experience levels. Foster a culture where intellectual curiosity is celebrated, where experimentation is encouraged, and where people feel safe enough to take risks and learn loudly from what doesn't work. Attract and retain engineers who are hungry, inventive, and proud of both the quality of what they ship today and the audacity of what they're building toward.

Reimagine and modernize critical platforms
Oversee the full lifecycle of the applications and services central to Fitch's Corporates, Financial Institutions, and Sovereigns analytical workflows. Balance the discipline of maintaining production-grade systems with the creative ambition to tear down and rebuild what no longer serves the business well. Be the person in the room who asks "what if we started over?" — and who knows when that's exactly the right call.

Drive greenfield innovation without apology
Identify and actively pursue opportunities to design and build net-new applications and platforms that replace or leapfrog legacy approaches. Embrace the blank canvas — and bring the rigor of world-class software delivery with you. This is an organization that wants to see bets placed, experiments run, and lessons learned fast. Be the kind of leader who creates that energy and channels it into things that last.

Push the frontier of AI, ML, and intelligent systems
Go beyond adopting AI tools — define how intelligent systems become structural, load-bearing parts of the platforms your teams own. Whether that's LLM-powered workflows, ML models embedded in analytical processes, agentic automation, or AI-augmented developer tooling, bring the depth to evaluate, architect, and champion these capabilities with real technical conviction. If you've built ML systems from the ground up, that experience will resonate deeply here — and you'll have the platform to apply it in genuinely high-stakes, high-visibility ways.

Influence across a complex and interconnected stakeholder landscape
Act as a strategic partner to a broad and diverse set of stakeholders — including senior leadership, analytical teams, operations, and business relationship management — whose workflows and outcomes depend directly on the platforms your teams own. Navigate a rich ecosystem of technical interdependencies, partnering with peer engineering teams whose systems integrate with, depend on, or are shaped by what your teams build. Build organizational credibility through consistent delivery, clear technical vision, and the ability to bring bold ideas to life in ways that earn trust across the business.

What You Need To Have

18+ years of hands-on software engineering experience , with substantial time in senior technical leadership roles overseeing multiple teams and disciplines
Proven multi-team leadership — demonstrated experience leading team leads and engineers across full-stack disciplines; a track record of building high-performing, inventive engineering cultures at meaningful scale
Deep technical credibility and hands-on instinct — strong command of modern software architecture, cloud-native platforms, and production-grade application delivery; you know when to go deep, and your teams and peers will know it too
Full-stack engineering expertise — proven background with modern enterprise technology stacks, including React, Java, and/or Python in production environments, deployed across AWS and/or Azure
A bias for experimentation and innovation — a demonstrable history of pushing technical boundaries, challenging inherited assumptions, and driving teams toward approaches that are meaningfully better — not just incrementally improved
Modernization and greenfield experience — proven ability to evolve existing platforms while simultaneously designing and delivering new systems; comfort making bold architectural decisions in both constrained legacy and open greenfield environments
People leadership and talent development — demonstrated ability to attract, grow, and retain exceptional engineers and engineering leaders; a builder of teams as much as systems, with a genuine investment in the growth of the people around you
Cross-functional stakeholder management — proven ability to partner effectively across analytical, operational, and business-facing teams as well as peer technical organizations; skilled at managing competing priorities and driving alignment across a complex interdependency landscape
Executive communication — the ability to translate bold technical vision for non-technical audiences, build trust through delivery, and make complex ideas land clearly at every level of the organization
Education: Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related technical field — or equivalent expertise demonstrated through impact

What Would Make You Stand Out

An ML or AI engineering background — if you've spent meaningful time building machine learning systems, training models, designing intelligent pipelines, or architecting AI-native applications, that depth is genuinely exciting for this role and will shape how you lead, what you build, and the kind of talent you attract
Deep cloud-native expertise — hands-on mastery of AWS and/or Azure, Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, microservices architecture, and sophisticated CI/CD and deployment pipelines for large-scale application delivery
Generative AI and intelligent systems experience — hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG architectures, agentic workflows, or production ML systems; the ability to move between engineering credibility and strategic vision without losing altitude
AI-native delivery leadership — direct experience implementing AI-augmented development lifecycles, intelligent testing pipelines, or AI-assisted tooling that materially raises the quality and velocity of engineering teams
Transformation and platform modernization leadership — a history of successfully reimagining complex, production-critical platforms while maintaining delivery continuity and rallying teams around a compelling future state
A maverick streak with enterprise judgment — the rare combination of someone who genuinely challenges conventions and moves with urgency, but knows how to do it within a complex organization without losing stakeholders along the way
Financial services domain knowledge — familiarity with analytical workflows, credit ratings processes, or how technology creates leverage in financial decision-making
Technical thought leadership — contributing to open source, speaking at industry events, publishing engineering content, or establishing technical direction that influences well beyond your immediate team

What We Offer

A genuine mandate to innovate — not a talking point, but real organizational backing to question, challenge, and rebuild the platforms powering some of Fitch's most critical business lines
Executive visibility and strategic influence — direct access to senior leadership, the platform to shape engineering direction across consequential lines of business, and the opportunity to leave a lasting mark on how global financial intelligence is delivered
The intersection of depth and breadth — lead a capable, experienced engineering organization while simultaneously running a bold innovation agenda; this role sits at a genuinely rare intersection of operational accountability and creative freedom
A place where ML and AI expertise becomes architecture — if you've built intelligent systems, this is an environment where that knowledge doesn't sit on the shelf; it shapes product direction, platform design, and how the organization thinks about what's next
Cutting-edge technology and continuous learning — access to the latest AI tools, frameworks, platforms; training and conference budgets; and the expectation that you'll stay at the leading edge and pull your teams forward with you
Career acceleration at scale — high visibility to the most senior leaders at Fitch, a clear path to principal and executive roles, and the opportunity to define what AI-driven financial technology looks like in practice
A culture that rewards curiosity — an environment where bold ideas are welcomed, where experimentation is celebrated, and where the best thinking wins regardless of where it comes from

Why Fitch?

At Fitch Group, the combined power of our global perspectives is what differentiates us. Our global network of colleagues comes together to accomplish things greater than they ever could alone.

Every team member is essential to our business, and each perspective is critical to our success. We embrace a diverse culture that encourages a free exchange of ideas, guaranteeing your voice will be heard and your work will have an impact, regardless of seniority.

We are building incredible things at Fitch and we invite you to join us on our journey.

About Fitch Group

Fitch Group is a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries. Wholly owned by the Hearst Corporation, we are comprised of three main businesses: Fitch Ratings | Fitch Solutions | Fitch Learning.

For more information please visit our websites: www.fitchratings.com | www.fitchsolutions.com | www.fitchlearning.com

Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. As the Software Manager, you will take ownership of the software engineering function, ensuring the design, development, and integration of primarily embedded software, applied to control and drive technology for vacuum applications. You will lead a technical team, shaping the engineering delivery strategy and maintaining excellence in software solutions. You will report to our Engineering Manager.

Main Responsibilities

Guide and manage the overall capability of the software engineering function, ensuring alignment with industry standards and company objectives.
Oversee the design and development of embedded software and HMIs for vacuum equipment, driving innovation and efficiency in scientific and semiconductor applications.
Define engineering strategies, ensuring robust hardware/software integration to optimize performance and reliability.
Manage and mentor a high-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including project management, hardware engineering, test engineering and manufacturing, to ensure seamless execution of projects.
Ensure compliance with relevant industry regulations, safety standards, and emerging technologies.
Drive continuous improvement, leveraging new methodologies to enhance engineering efficiency and product quality.

Experience in coaching and developing engineering talent to foster growth and innovation within teams.
Strong capabilities in stakeholder engagement, process optimization, and leading organizational change initiatives.
Robust background in complex enterprise environments with broad exposure to diverse business functions and operational challenges.
Deep understanding of integrating business strategy with software delivery, ensuring alignment of projects with long-term objectives.
