and see your impact at scale.

Job Description:

Job Summary

We are looking for a Product Engineer to join our AI Search and Retrieval Context Engineering as we build the next generation of legal AI experiences for law firms.

This is not a traditional front-end developer role where requirements are handed over and built from a specification. It is a hands-on product engineering role for someone who can understand the problem, shape the user experience, think through the system design and then build high-quality software.

The role is primarily focused on React, TypeScript and modern user experience development, but the expectation is broader than UI delivery. You will work close to lawyers, knowledge teams, innovation teams and technical stakeholders to understand how AI search, retrieval and agents should fit into real legal workflows.

We are not building another disconnected AI chatbot. We are building trusted AI experiences that sit on top of the firm’s own documents, knowledge, matters, metadata and workflows.

As a Product Engineer, you will help turn complex AI retrieval capability into simple, useful and trusted experiences for lawyers.

Why This Role Matters

AI is changing software engineering. The value of an engineer is no longer only in writing code quickly. AI can now help generate code, tests and components at speed. That makes the human part of engineering more important, not less.

The best engineers are now the ones who understand the system, the user, the constraints and the business problem.

For this team, that means understanding why a lawyer is searching, what they need to trust an answer, what happens if the wrong document is surfaced, how permissions work, how citations should be displayed, and how the experience fits into their daily workflow.

A button is not just a button. A search result is not just a card. An AI answer is not just text on a page.

In legal AI, every interaction has to support trust, explainability, security and adoption.

That is why we need Product Engineers: people who are fluent in engineering, fluent in product thinking, and willing to understand the domain deeply enough to build the right thing.

About The Team

The Search & AI team helps law firms build secure, firm-specific AI capabilities on top of their existing document, knowledge and matter infrastructure.

We work with firms that want to move beyond standalone AI tools and create a trusted AI layer inside their own environment. Our solutions typically connect to systems such as iManage, SharePoint, NetDocuments, Microsoft 365, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI and internal knowledge platforms.

The team already has experience delivering AI search and workflow capabilities for a Magic Circle law firm and a global multinational law firm, including natural language search, agents and Azure-based retrieval solutions built in partnership with Microsoft.

As the market shifts from AI adoption to AI ownership, our team is becoming more like a Forward Deployment Engineering function: technical people who work close to strategic clients, understand their workflows, and build real solutions that move from prototype to production.

The Role

You will design and build the product experience layer for legal AI.

That includes search interfaces, AI answer experiences, document previews, citation views, agent workflows, feedback loops, dashboards, admin screens and embedded components for tools lawyers already use.

You will mainly work in React and TypeScript, building polished, enterprise-grade applications that are fast, accessible, secure and suitable for professional legal users.

You will work with AI engineers, retrieval architects, Azure engineers, legal knowledge experts and client stakeholders to turn complex technical capabilities into clear, usable products.

What You Will Build

You may build a natural language search experience that allows lawyers to ask questions across a firm’s knowledge bank and receive grounded answers with citations.

You may create a source preview panel that lets a lawyer inspect the exact document behind an AI answer before relying on it.

You may design an agent workflow where a lawyer can run a research task, review retrieved documents, refine the question, compare outputs and export the result.

You may build dashboards that show search quality, adoption, answer confidence, feedback trends and retrieval performance.

You may create embedded components for SharePoint, Teams, Word, Outlook or a firm intranet, so AI appears inside the workflow rather than as another destination.

The common thread is that you will be building the experience layer that makes AI usable, explainable and trusted.

Key Responsibilities

Build high-quality React and TypeScript applications

You will build modern front-end applications using React, TypeScript and strong component design. You will care about performance, accessibility, responsiveness, error handling, loading states, empty states, maintainability and the overall quality of the user experience. You will work with APIs, authentication, permissions, search services, AI responses, document metadata and workflow actions.

Shape the product, not just the code

You will help define how legal AI experiences should work. This means challenging unclear requirements, simplifying complex workflows, proposing better interaction patterns and making sure the team is building something users will actually adopt. You will not just wait for a perfect specification. You will help create it.

Understand the lawyer workflow

You will work close to legal users and client teams to understand how lawyers search for knowledge, review documents, validate answers and move through their work. The goal is to build AI into workflows lawyers already understand, rather than sending them to another disconnected tool.

Turn AI retrieval into trusted UX

You will design interfaces that make retrieval transparent. This includes citations, source previews, metadata, snippets, filters, document cards, confidence signals, feedback mechanisms and audit-friendly interaction patterns. In legal AI, the user needs to understand where an answer came from and why it should be trusted.

Work across the system

Although this is mainly a React and TypeScript role, you will need to understand how your UI fits into the wider system. That may include Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, retrieval APIs, MCP-style tool access, document processing pipelines, security trimming, Microsoft Graph, SharePoint, iManage or other enterprise systems. You do not need to own every layer, but you should understand how the layers connect.

Use AI as part of your engineering workflow

We expect Product Engineers to use AI effectively in their own work. That may include using AI to generate code drafts, test ideas, explore components, accelerate refactoring or support documentation. But the judgement remains yours. AI can help write code. It cannot own the product intent, system consequences or user trust.

Required Skills

You should have strong hands-on experience with React and TypeScript.

You should be comfortable building component-based applications, working with APIs, handling complex state and delivering polished enterprise user interfaces. Experience with Next.js would be useful, but is not essential.

You should understand modern front-end development practices, including authentication flows, role-based permissions, asynchronous data, loading states, error states, accessibility, testing, source control and CI/CD.

Experience with some of the following would be valuable: React Query, Zustand, Redux, Tailwind, Fluent UI, Material UI, Vite, Next.js, Storybook, Playwright, Jest, Azure Static Web Apps, Azure App Service or Microsoft Graph.

You do not need to be a deep AI engineer, but you should be interested in AI product design and willing to learn how retrieval, citations, agents and RAG systems work.

Product Engineering Mindset

The strongest candidates will think beyond tickets.

You should be someone who wants to understand why something is being built, not just how to build it. You should be comfortable working in ambiguity, forming a point of view, testing ideas quickly and improving based on feedback.

You should care about systems. You should want to understand how the UI, API, retrieval layer, permissions model and user workflow fit together.

You should be able to see where a small UI decision could create confusion, risk or unnecessary friction.

You should also care about product quality. Legal users are time-poor and sceptical of poor AI experiences. The interface needs to be clear, reliable and professional.

This is a role for someone who wants to use engineering judgement, product instinct and domain understanding together.

AI and Search Awareness

You will work around AI search and retrieval systems, so you should be interested in concepts such as retrieval-augmented generation, semantic search, vector search, hybrid search, document chunking, citations, source grounding, prompt workflows and agentic interfaces.

You do not need to build all of this from scratch, but you do need to understand enough to design good user experiences around it.

For example, when an AI answer is shown, the UI should help the lawyer answer practical questions: Where did this answer come from? Can I open the source? Is this the latest version? Which jurisdiction does this relate to? Who authored it? Can I trust this document? What should I do next?

That is product engineering in legal AI.

Desirable Experience

Experience in any of the following would be useful: legal technology, enterprise search, document management systems, knowledge management, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, iManage, NetDocuments, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Graph, Power Platform, SaaS products, internal tools, workflow platforms or professional services.

Experience building search interfaces, AI interfaces, dashboards, document review tools, knowledge portals or workflow applications would be particularly relevant.

What Success Looks Like

Success means the team builds AI products that lawyers actually use.

A successful search experience will help a lawyer find the right precedent, legal opinion or knowledge document quickly and confidently.

A successful answer experience will make the source material visible, citeable and easy to inspect.

A successful agent workflow will guide the user through a complex task without hiding important decisions.

A successful product will feel simple on the surface, even though the system underneath is complex.

More broadly, success means helping law firms move from AI experimentation to AI capability they can trust, own and scale.

Example Projects

A legal knowledge search application over SharePoint or iManage content.
A React/TypeScript AI answer interface with citations, filters and source previews.
A document preview panel showing metadata, snippets and highlighted evidence.
An agent workflow for precedent discovery, matter research or legal opinion search.
A dashboard showing adoption, answer quality, feedback and retrieval performance.
An embedded SharePoint or Teams component that brings AI search into an existing lawyer workflow.
A configuration experience for managing sources, prompts, retrieval settings or access controls.
A feedback interface that helps improve retrieval quality over time.

jobs.title: Frontend Developer (F/M/X)
jobs.description:
PROMITEL to wiodący polski dystrybutor nowoczesnych systemów bezpieczeństwa. Specjalizujemy się w imporcie i sprzedaży technologii z zakresu telewizji przemysłowej (CCTV), systemów alarmowych oraz kontroli dostępu. Od lat dostarczamy kompleksowe, innowacyjne rozwiązania, współpracując z najlepszymi producentami w branży i stawiając na partnerskie relacje z naszymi klientami.

Nasze aplikacje biznesowe tworzymy w technologii .NET. Obecnie poszukujemy doświadczonego Front-End/.NET Developera, którego głównym i wiodącym zadaniem będzie projektowanie oraz rozwój nowoczesnego, wysoce funkcjonalnego sklepu e-commerce B2B/B2C opartego o platformę nopCommerce. Szukamy osoby, która połączy doskonałą znajomość front-endu ze zrozumieniem ekosystemu .NET, tworząc intuicyjne interfejsy, spójne i zoptymalizowane pod kątem konwersji oraz wygody użytkowania.

Nie szukamy wyłącznie osoby od HTML i CSS. Szukamy samodzielnego programisty z doświadczeniem, który potrafi zaprojektować i wdrożyć zaawansowany interfejs użytkownika w systemach e-commerce i aplikacjach biznesowych.

Zakres Obowiązków

Projektowanie i wdrażanie responsywnych interfejsów użytkownika, ze szczególnym uwzględnieniem platformy nopCommerce,
Tworzenie i dostosowywanie szablonów, widoków oraz komponentów w środowisku .NET (Razor Components/Blazor),
Implementacja nowych funkcjonalności e-commerce zgodnie z wymaganiami biznesowymi i specyfiką handlu B2B/B2C,
Dbanie o jakość, czytelność i reużywalność kodu,
Utrzymywanie i rozwijanie istniejących komponentów UI,
Współpraca z UX/UI Designerami oraz zespołem backendowym,
Udział w analizie wymagań i proponowanie rozwiązań technicznych,
Testowanie i poprawianie funkcjonalności interfejsu,
Identyfikowanie i rozwiązywanie problemów związanych z UI/UX,
Optymalizacja wydajności aplikacji,
Dbanie o dostępność (accessibility) tworzonych interfejsów,
Udział w code review i dbanie o standardy programistyczne,
Tworzenie i aktualizowanie dokumentacji komponentów oraz rozwiązań UI,
Monitorowanie nowych technologii i trendów związanych z frontendem,
Współpraca przy tworzeniu i utrzymaniu standardów wizualnych aplikacji.

Poszukiwane Kompetencje

Bardzo dobra znajomość i doświadczenie komercyjne:
HTML5 | CSS3 | JavaScript | Responsive Web Design,

Doświadczenie w pracy z ekosystemem:
.NET | Blazor | Razor Components/Views | ASP.NET Core (w stopniu pozwalającym na swobodną integrację front-endu z back-endem) | Praktyczna znajomość platformy nopCommerce (tworzenie motywów, modyfikacja widoków, znajomość architektury front-endu platformy)

Dobra znajomość:
Bootstrap/Git | Umiejętność projektowania zorientowanego na użytkownika (UX/UI Design) oraz praca z narzędziami typu Figma.

Mile widziane:

MudBlazor, Radzen, Telerik UI) | Doświadczenie w projektowaniu zaawansowanych paneli administracyjnych, systemów B2B oraz aplikacji desktopowych (WPF/XAML) | Znajomość trendów e-commerce i mechanizmów optymalizacji.

Oferujemy

Zatrudnienie na umowę o pracę, pełen etat,
Realny wpływ na wygląd tworzonych produktów,
Udział w ciekawych projektach biznesowych,
Premię miesięczną za osiągnięte wyniki,
Realne możliwości rozwoju, awansu i wzrostu wynagrodzenia,
Stabilną pracę z najlepszymi producentami o światowym zasięgu,
Pracę w zaangażowanym i wspierającym się zespole,
Pracę w dynamicznie rozwijającej się firmie,
Dostęp do najnowszych technologii oraz zniżki pracownicze,
Niezbędne narzędzia pracy (laptop, telefon),

jobs.title: Expert Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

Division: Group Business Solutions (GBS)

Your career opportunity

Join our Group Business Solutions (GBS) division, where we design and sustain IT solutions for financial market securities. Be part of a dynamic, collaborative team in a fast-evolving environment, shaping the future of financial technology.
Ready to make an impact?

We’re seeking a skilled and proactive Expert Engineer eager to broaden their expertise and drive impactful improvements across our solutions. You’ll tackle complex problems and help shape our delivery, working in a collaborative environment that supports growth, fosters innovation and strengthens our alignment with business needs.
Your Day-to-day Mission

Lead the design, architecture, and development of technical and functional solutions, owning complex features and collaborating with senior developers and cross‑functional teams to deliver robust, scalable systems. Provide expert input to technical decisions and support junior colleagues in resolving medium‑to‑high‑complexity issues.
Contribute and actively shape ideation workshops by providing expert insights and recommending enhancements to improve product functionality and user experience
Drive the definition, estimation, and validation of complex technical requirements, proactively influencing planning accuracy and enabling predictable, high‑quality feature delivery across teams.
Ensure the stability and reliability of production applications by independently leading technical investigations, implementing durable fixes, and guiding peers in troubleshooting.
Lead the creation and improvement of design documentation for medium‑to‑high‑complexity changes, ensuring technical clarity and alignment with architectural standards while contributing to stronger design practices across the team.
Drive the adoption and evolution of best practices and coding standards to ensure high code quality, while leading and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives across the team.
Take ownership of applications (quality, support, evolution)
Perform production support (including off-hours when required)

What you need to have to succeed in this role:

Hands-on experience as a software engineer (at least 5 years) .
Advanced understanding of software related system designs and technology stacks.
Solid knowledge of solution development and design principles.
Ability to interpret business requirements, assess their technical implications, and help translate them into well‑scoped, practical technical solutions.
Proactive in learning and expanding technical expertise, while contributing to team goals, engaging in cross‑functional projects, and supporting cloud migration efforts, AI integration, automation frameworks, Infrastructure as Code best practices and effective collaboration within and across teams
Strong command of English, both spoken and written.
Hands-on experience with tools/platforms such as:
Mainframe: PL/I or Cobol, DB2, MQ, CICS
Nice to have:
Java / .NET / APIs / Integration
Azure, Kafka, event-driven architecture
IntelliJ IDEA, Eclipse, JDK, Javac/Java commands, Maven, Gradle, IDE environments, JUnit, Git, Docker, CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, VisualVM, JFR, Kubernetes, Azure Cloud, AWS, GCP, VPC/VNet, CLI, Visual Studio, Oracle, CSS, SSIS, APIs, MQ Series, Linux, Togaf, CoBit.

What Makes You Stand Out

Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving abilities
A strong sense of ownership and accountability in your work
Proactive attitude with a structured and solution-oriented approach Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders
Ability to collaborate effectively in a multicultural environment
Clear and effective communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Coaching and mentoring capabilities, with a willingness to support team growth
A continuous learning mindset and drive for improvement  Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving abilities
Knowledge of Agile methodologies.

Work outside of business hours is sometimes required as launches in production are generally carried out after 5PM or on Saturday as well as watch duty during nights and weekends.

Please note that this is a permanent position, and we do not offer freelance or contract arrangements for this role.

About Us

Why join us

Embark on your new adventure at Euroclear, and work at the heart of the global capital markets. We connect over 2,000 financial institutions across the globe. As an open and resilient infrastructure, we contribute to the stability of the financial markets. We help clients cut through complexity, lower costs, and mitigate risks of financial transactions. At Euroclear, we have the clear ambition to use our key role to facilitate and accelerate a sustainable global financial system.
What We Offer

Work closely with inspiring, supportive and engaged colleagues from more than 80 different countries.
Practice your talents in a highly professional international environment.
Join a learning and development environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing and training.
Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits.

Ways of working

Find your own optimal balance within our hybrid working model, where you can connect at the office 8 days a month and also benefit from remote working.
Great Place to Work for All

We are committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates diversity and strives to be a Great Place to Work for All. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment, regardless of any aspect that makes them unique (including race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, pregnancy, disability, ...). If you need any specific accommodation due to disability or any other reason, you can let the recruiter know during your application process. Our values guide how we work together and shape our future: Our mission and values - Euroclear
About The Team

The Group Business Solutions (GBS) division ensures the competitiveness of Euroclear by delivering reliable and sustainable IT solutions for the financial securities markets. Our technical teams deliver new IT solutions and improve existing applications for both our internal and external clients. We deploy changes into the production environment in a controlled and structured way that doesn't compromise production stability and we ensure applicative production support.

jobs.title: Web Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Our client is an established technology consultancy founded in 2010, with a portfolio of more than 500 completed projects. The company focuses on digital strategy, UX/UI design, and the development of mobile apps, web platforms and AI-driven agents. They help organizations build cohesive digital ecosystems by combining creative design with robust engineering practices. Flexible engagement models — project teams, dedicated squads and on-demand digital specialists — enable tailored delivery to match client needs and timelines. The culture emphasizes collaboration, high-quality user experiences and tangible business outcomes. Currently recruiting digital experts: UX/UI designers, mobile engineers, web developers and AI specialists eager to create advanced digital products on modern platforms. This is a compelling opportunity for professionals who value innovation, teamwork and direct impact on client-facing digital solutions.

Web Solution Architect

location: Gdańsk

Responsibilities

Analysis of business needs and functional and non-functional requirements.
Designing target solution architecture, integration approach, data flow and communication with external systems.
Designing scalable integrations, APIs and cross-platform solutions.
Making and justifying decisions regarding technologies, frameworks, libraries and tools.
Assessing impact of architectural decisions on performance, security, maintainability, scalability and implementation cost.
Preparing architectural documentation, diagrams, technical standards and recommendations for teams.
Conducting discovery conversations with clients and identifying real needs, constraints and risks.
Presenting proposed architecture, technological solutions and estimations.
Supporting preparation of proposals, estimations, responses to tenders and RFPs.
Technical leadership of development teams throughout the project lifecycle.
Organizing the technical part of Sprint 0, including preparation of environments, repositories, CI/CD, coding, testing and security standards.
Defining and enforcing clean code standards, good architectural practices and quality principles.
Conducting architecture reviews and supporting the team during code reviews.
Mentoring less experienced team members and supporting them in solving difficult technical problems.
Identifying technical risks and communicating them to project stakeholders.
Collaborating with UX/UI, QA, backend, frontend, mobile, DevOps and Delivery teams.
Supporting responsible use of AI tools in development, testing, code reviews and documentation.
Ensuring high standards of security, data protection and compliance of solutions with GDPR requirements.
Designing architecture of modern web applications.
Designing collaboration between frontend, backend, APIs and cloud services.
Modernizing existing systems, refactoring and migrating legacy solutions.
Overseeing performance, security of web applications, caching, monitoring and technical debt.

Position Requirements

Minimum 4 years of experience in a role involving architectural responsibility or technical project leadership, e.g., Solution Architect, Software Architect, Tech Lead, or Senior Developer.
Many years of practical experience in building and deploying applications.
Ability to design complete end-to-end solutions, not just individual components.
Very good knowledge of design patterns, clean architecture, clean code principles, and modular system design.
Experience in designing APIs, integrating with external systems, and backend solutions.
Familiarity with CI/CD processes, test automation, code review, and quality assurance practices.
Experience with cloud architecture, e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Ability to assess trade-offs between business value, delivery time, costs, and technical complexity.
Experience in conducting technical workshops, client meetings, or solution presentations.
Ability to communicate technical matters to both development teams and business stakeholders.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Very good command of English, minimum B2, enabling smooth work with clients and international teams.

Specialist requirements

Very good knowledge of modern web application architecture.
Practical experience designing backend and frontend applications.
Experience with a stack including PHP, Laravel, React.js, or Vue.js.
Very good knowledge of REST API and integration with external systems.
Ability to design scalable applications, backend services, and cloud-based solutions.
Knowledge of web application security, performance, caching, and monitoring.
Experience in modernizing systems, refactoring, or migrating legacy solutions.

Nice To Have

Experience in a software house, digital agency, or a company delivering projects for external clients.
Work on projects executed under the fixed-price model.
Experience in creating proof of concept and technical prototypes.
Practical knowledge of tools supporting development using AI.
Experience in projects executed by distributed, international teams.

Benefits Offered

Stable, long-term cooperation based on an employment contract or B2B contract.
Hybrid model - work from the office in Gdańsk on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
Participation in international projects for well-known clients.
Real influence on architecture, technology choices and project execution methods.
Opportunity to combine architectural work, technical leadership and client collaboration.
Cooperation with experienced development, design and product teams.
Environment open to new technologies, improvements and initiative.
Private medical care, Multisport card and language learning subsidies.
Salary up to 34,000 PLN net per month on B2B or the equivalent total employer cost for an employment contract.

wsparcie utrzymania bazy danych zarządzania konfiguracją (CMDB) na platformie ServiceNow,
rozwój i integracja aplikacji w środowisku ServiceNow oraz Azure,
tworzenie kodu oraz wykonywanie testów jednostkowych,
udział w modyfikacji oprogramowania podczas testów integracyjnych,
opracowywanie efektywnego oprogramowania zgodnie z wymaganiami biznesowymi, uwzględniając odpowiednie procesy, narzędzia i metody, zapewniając zgodność z dyrektywami bezpieczeństwa IT oraz proponowanie innowacji w celu zwiększenia wydajności systemu i obniżenia kosztów operacyjnych,
zbieranie wymagań, planowanie i ustalanie planu zarządzania konfiguracją oprogramowania,
zapewnienie przeprowadzenia niezbędnych i odpowiednich przeglądów i audytów produktu.

Co dalej?

Prześlij swoje CV w języku angielskim, uzupełniając formularz.
Jeśli pojawi się projekt, w który będziemy mogli Cię zaangażować - skontaktujemy się z Tobą.
Nie martw się jednak brakiem informacji z naszej strony - oznacza to, że obecnie nie mamy propozycji dla Ciebie. Twoje dane pozostaną w naszym systemie do czasu wygaśnięcia Twojej zgody.

Poleć nam swojego znajomego!

Znalazłeś/aś się tu przypadkiem, a może oferta nie jest dla Ciebie? Poleć nam osobę na to stanowisko, a w razie podjęcia współpracy przekażemy Ci bonus w wysokości 8 000 zł brutto.

Jak to zrobić? Prześlij imię i nazwisko oraz e-mail poleconej osoby, a także nazwę roli, na którą chcesz ją polecić, na nasz adres: rekrutacja@etteplan.com , w odpowiedzi otrzymasz informację o dalszych krokach w procesie rekomendacji.

jobs.title: Citizen Developer AI & Power Platforms
jobs.description:
Job Description

Division:
Compliance and Public Affairs

We are a dynamic team dedicated to managing Financial Crime risks across the Euroclear Group, including Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Sanctions, and related compliance domains. As a key component of the Three Lines of Defence, Compliance & Ethics plays a critical role in safeguarding Euroclear’s integrity, protecting its reputation, and ensuring trust in the financial markets.

This opportunity sits within the Analytics & Tooling Team of the Compliance & Ethics Department, which is leading the digital transformation of Compliance & Ethics through the strategic use of AI, data, and digital solutions. We are seeking an individual who combines strong technical expertise with intellectual curiosity, problem-solving capabilities, and business acumen, while embracing and driving positive change.

Role

The role offers a unique opportunity to citizen development solutions for Compliance & Ethics using technologies such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate design and develop practical AI agents .
The successful candidate will also contribute to the development of data products leveraging the Cloud Data Platform, helping unlock insights and improve operational effectiveness across the function.

Alongside these technology-focused responsibilities, the role provides the opportunity to deepen your knowledge of financial crime compliance, governance, controls, and compliance practices, enabling you to build both technical and regulatory expertise in a high-impact and highly visible environment. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is passionate about innovation and eager to help shape the future of Compliance & Ethics.

Your Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

Support the divisional vision and strategy of providing smart, sensible data and digital solutions to empower Compliance & Ethics teams.
Act as the main interface between IT teams and specific business/functional areas from Compliance & ethics for end to end digital transformation providing solution building, roll outs and maintenance.
Administration and technical advisory for various compliance service domains and IT /Data/AI tools.
Elicit business functional and non-functional requirements and create clear perennial documentation (business process diagrams, high-level and detailed requirements, etc.).
Lead or contribute to citizen development initiatives using Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate, translating business needs into simple, robust, and maintainable solutions that improve efficiency, insight, and user experience.
Lead or contribute to the identification, design, development, testing, deployment, and adoption of practical AI agents and AI-enabled solutions, with a strong focus on Copilot Studio and Microsoft 365 Copilot capabilities.
Build effective relationships and establish proactive interactions with Compliance teams, business managers, data suppliers, IT specialists, Power Platform experts, and other data analysts across the company.
Explore business problems with curiosity, challenge current ways of working, propose practical ideas, and contribute to initiatives that improve the functioning and productivity of the division through data, automation, AI, and citizen development.
Continuously learn, assess, and apply new technologies pragmatically, while also developing business understanding, compliance knowledge, and awareness of governance, risk management, and internal control practices.

Required Qualification

Technical Skills

You have a master's degree in a field whereAI/data is relevantor equivalent professional experience/specific certifications.
You have at least five years of experience in data, analytics, automation, AI, citizen development, digital solution delivery, or a related field.
You cananalyzebusiness flows and business problems, understand user needs, and translate them into practical, value-adding solutions.
You have hands-on experience with, or a strong ambition to develop expertise in, Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot, AI agents, prompt design, and practical AI use cases in a business environment.
You have hands-on experience with, or a strong ambition to develop expertise in, citizen development using Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate, including building solutions that are simple, maintainable, and adopted by users.
Experience with the following technologies is a plus:Copilot,Office 365, SharePoint, Teams, Power Platform, Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio, relational databases and SQL,clouddataplatform(data lake), and Python.
Belonging to, and being active in, communities such as WeConnect, Power Platform, Power BI, Copilot, AI, or Data Scientist communities is a plus.

Soft skills

You are self-confident, autonomous, and able to work effectively as part of a team.
You are curious, analytical, and motivated by solving concrete business problems.
You can collect, manage, evaluate, and use data and user requirements with sound critical thinking, strong data literacy, and a pragmatic delivery mindset.
You have strong presentation and communication skills and can promote the adoption of the AI, data, and citizen development solutions you build.
You are willing to continuously learn and develop not only technical skills, but also business understanding, compliance knowledge, and awareness of governance, risk management, and internal control.
You build relationships in a consultative style and care as much about how work is deliveredas well asabout what is delivered.
You take ownership of your assignments, handle them with empowerment, and seek consultation when necessary.
You can influence, constructively challenge, and negotiate at all levels.
You areorganisedand able to manage priorities autonomously.
You have excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

We offer

The opportunity to grow your career in a top-class compliance department with a strong reputation for excellence and quality, within a highly diverse team of motivated professionals.
A role at the intersection of Compliance, AI development, citizen development, data, automation, and innovation, with the chance to help shape practical Copilot Studio, Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate use cases for the division.
Exposure to a wide range of data, digital, AI, and Power Platform technologies, as well as some of the most strategic and sensitive data in the company.
The possibility to deepen your knowledge of Euroclear businesses, Compliance, ethics, governance, risk management, and internal control, while further developing your AI, automation, and citizen development expertise.
Continuous professional development, with up to 10 days of training per year.
A comprehensive and transversal view of Euroclear and its businesses.
Support to acquire external qualifications and professional certifications.
A flexible work environment combining office presence and teleworking, with trust, accountability, and flexibility.

About Us

Why join us

Embark on your new adventure at Euroclear, and work at the heart of the global capital markets. We connect over 2,000 financial institutions across the globe. As an open and resilient infrastructure, we contribute to the stability of the financial markets. We help clients cut through complexity, lower costs, and mitigate risks of financial transactions. At Euroclear, we have the clear ambition to use our key role to facilitate and accelerate a sustainable global financial system.

What We Offer

Work closely with inspiring, supportive and engaged colleagues from more than 80 different countries.
Practice your talents in a highly professional international environment.
Join a learning and development environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing and training.
Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits.

Ways of working

Find your own optimal balance within our hybrid working model, where you can connect at the office 8 days a month and also benefit from remote working.

Great Place to Work for All

We are committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates diversity and strives to be a Great Place to Work for All. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment, regardless of any aspect that makes them unique (including race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, pregnancy, disability, ...). If you need any specific accommodation due to disability or any other reason, you can let the recruiter know during your application process. Our values guide how we work together and shape our future: Our mission and values - Euroclear

jobs.title: Senior Java Developer with German (M/F/NB)
jobs.description:
W Etteplan wierzymy, że technologia ma wartość tylko wtedy, gdy realnie wspiera ludzi i procesy. Tworzymy rozwiązania, które działają w praktyce – są skalowalne, stabilne i projektowane z myślą o długofalowym wykorzystaniu. Łączymy wiedzę techniczną z doświadczeniem projektowym zdobywanym w branżach przemysłowych i technologicznych. Pracujemy w międzynarodowym środowisku, stawiając na jakość, współpracę i ciągłe doskonalenie.

Projekt realizowany jest dla międzynarodowej firmy technologicznej z branży automotive, rozwijającej zaawansowaną platformę SaaS wspierającą sprzedaż i obsługę klientów. Rozwiązanie integruje procesy marketingowe, sprzedażowe i obsługę posprzedażową w jednym systemie, wspierając organizacje w zarządzaniu relacjami z klientami i optymalizacji procesów biznesowych.

Dlaczego warto rozważyć ten projekt?

To propozycja dla osób, które chcą pracować nad rozwojem skalowalnego produktu SaaS, wykorzystywanego w codziennej pracy przez organizacje na wielu rynkach. Projekt jest w fazie intensywnego rozwoju, co oznacza realny wpływ na architekturę, technologie oraz kierunek rozwoju platformy. Pracujesz w środowisku fullstackowym — zarówno przy backendzie (Java), jak i frontendzie (TypeScript), mając wpływ na cały cykl życia produktu. W projekcie wykorzystujesz język niemiecki w komunikacji z interesariuszami, jednocześnie pracując w szerszym, międzynarodowym środowisku.

W tej roli będziesz odpowiadać za:

rozwój i utrzymanie aplikacji webowej w modelu fullstack (Java + TypeScript),
implementację nowych funkcjonalności oraz rozwój logiki biznesowej po stronie backendu i frontendu,
projektowanie i rozwój API oraz integrację systemu z zewnętrznymi rozwiązaniami,
pracę z technologiami backendowymi (Java, Spring Boot) oraz bazami danych (MySQL, Elasticsearch),
rozwój warstwy frontendowej z wykorzystaniem TypeScript oraz frameworków takich jak Vue.js,
analizę wymagań biznesowych i ich przekład na rozwiązania techniczne,
dbanie o jakość kodu poprzez testy jednostkowe i integracyjne oraz udział w code review,
diagnozowanie i rozwiązywanie problemów technicznych w środowisku produkcyjnym,
współpracę z zespołem produktowym i interesariuszami biznesowymi,
udział w procesach Agile oraz rozwój i usprawnianie praktyk zespołowych.

Jesteś naszym brakującym ogniwem, jeśli:

masz minimum 5 lat doświadczenia w tworzeniu aplikacji fullstack,
pracujesz z językiem Java oraz frameworkiem Spring Boot,
masz doświadczenie w pracy z TypeScript oraz frameworkami frontendowymi (np. Vue.js, React lub Angular),
masz doświadczenie w tworzeniu API oraz integracji systemów,
pracowałeś/-aś z bazami danych (np. MySQL) oraz rozwiązaniami typu Elasticsearch,
masz doświadczenie w pracy w środowisku SaaS lub przy rozwoju produktów,
znasz metodyki Agile/Scrum i pracowałeś/-aś w zespołach developerskich,
posługujesz się językiem niemieckim na poziomie minimum B2,
posługujesz się językiem angielskim na poziomie minimum B2,
dbasz o jakość kodu i stosujesz dobre praktyki programistyczne.

Docenimy również:

doświadczenie z AWS,
doświadczenie w pracy z CI/CD (np. GitLab CI/CD),
doświadczenie w pracy z architekturą mikroserwisową,
doświadczenie w pracy z produktami CRM lub systemami sprzedażowymi.

W Etteplan możesz liczyć na:

pracę w międzynarodowym środowisku produktowym,
udział w rozwoju platformy wykorzystywanej na wielu rynkach,
możliwość pracy zdalnej,
realny wpływ na rozwój produktu i technologii,
współpracę z doświadczonym zespołem technologicznym.

Jak przebiega proces rekrutacyjny?

Wyślij nam swoje CV – najlepiej w języku angielskim. W formularzu daj nam znać, jakie masz oczekiwania finansowe, preferowaną formę współpracy oraz od kiedy możesz rozpocząć pracę.
Sprawdzimy Twoją aplikację – przyjrzymy się Twojemu doświadczeniu i zobaczymy, jak pasuje do tej roli i projektu.
Rozmowa z HR (online) – luźna, partnerska rozmowa (ok. 40–60 minut), żeby lepiej się poznać, porozmawiać o Twojej drodze zawodowej, motywacji i oczekiwaniach.
Krótkie spotkanie językowe (online) – około 10–15 minutowa rozmowa z native speakerem, podczas której zweryfikujemy Twoją znajomość języka niemieckiego.
Rozmowa techniczna (online) – spotkanie z osobami z zespołu projektowego.
Feedback – po zakończeniu procesu wrócimy do Ciebie z informacją zwrotną.

Możesz też zajrzeć na naszą stronę internetową lub Facebooka i zobaczyć, co ciekawego się u nas dzieje!

jobs.title: Senior .NET utvecklare inom AML
jobs.description:
Om rollen

Som Senior .NET-utvecklare blir du en nyckelperson i Skandias AML-team (Anti-Money Laundering), där ni utvecklar systemstöd för att förebygga penningtvätt och finansiering av terrorism – ett affärskritiskt uppdrag med tydlig samhällsnytta.

Du arbetar nära både verksamhet och teknik och är delaktig i att designa, utveckla och vidareutveckla stabila och säkra lösningar. Rollen innebär att bidra i design-, arkitektur- och kravdiskussioner samt vara med och fatta tekniska vägval tillsammans med teamet.

Arbetet fokuserar på backendutveckling i .NET/C# och eventdriven arkitektur i en säkerhetskänslig miljö med stora datamängder och höga krav på tillförlitlighet.

Du utvecklar och optimerar integrationer mot andra system, samarbetar nära teamet genom exempelvis par- och mobbprogrammering och bidrar till kontinuerlig förbättring av kod, arbetssätt och lösningar.

För att lyckas i rollen

Vi söker dig som trivs i en utvecklarroll där kvalitet, säkerhet och stabila lösningar är avgörande. Du är van att arbeta i affärskritiska systemmiljöer och har erfarenhet av att ta ansvar för tekniska lösningar genom hela utvecklingsprocessen – från design och implementation till vidareutveckling och förbättring.

Du arbetar strukturerat, har ett analytiskt förhållningssätt och trivs med att samarbeta nära andra utvecklare. Samtidigt delar du gärna med dig av din kunskap och bidrar till att utveckla både teamets arbetssätt och tekniska lösningar.

Du har även ett intresse för att ligga i framkant inom AI-stödd systemutveckling, till exempel genom verktyg som GitHub Copilot.

Du har erfarenhet av

Systemutveckling i C# / .NET
Backendutveckling och integrationer
Eventdriven arkitektur eller meddelandebaserade lösningar
ASP.NET / MVC och REST-baserade API:er
Databashantering med MS SQL, samt ORM-verktyg som EF Core eller Dapper
Versionshantering och CI/CD-flöden
Kommunikation på svenska, i tal och skrift

Vad händer nu?

Vi arbetar med löpande urval, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag.

Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller intervjuer, tester, bakgrundskontroll samt digital referenstagning för att säkerställa en rättvis och objektiv bedömning. Du kan läsa mer om vår process här.

Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Stephan Mannerfelt på stephan.mannerfelt@skandia.se

Om du har frågor om rekryteringsprocessen, vänligen kontakta Talent Acquisition Partner, Madelene Skogh, på madelene.skogh@skandia.se

Vi återkopplar till alla som söker, oavsett om du går vidare i processen eller inte.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Mer om IT

Vi på Skandia IT är stolta över att vara en kundorienterad enhet som levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar för våra kunder. Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsammans är vårt motto! 

Vi arbetar agilt och har sedan 2017 använt oss av SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) ramverket, där leverans och kundvärde alltid står i centrum. Våra tågledningar och team, jobbar verksamhetsbaserat med aktiviteter som sprintplanering, daily stand-ups, team-synk, code reviews och retrospektiv. 

Var 12:e vecka samlas vi alla i vår ljusa och inspirerande Ljusgård på kontoret i Stockholm för 2 planeringsdagar. Planeringsperioden består av 6 tvåveckorssprintar, där den sista sprinten är en innovationssprint. Här får du chansen att, själv eller tillsammans med ditt team, utveckla och förfina våra system.
